advisories.rule_name: PAGASA Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal Active

calendar_anchor.note: Advisory is anchored to matching current ACAP rice/corn calendar stage(s).

advisories.responsible_office: PAGASA + DA RFO 02 + LGU MDRRMC + MAO
adaptation_measures: Secure harvested produce, seed stocks, fertilizer, machinery, and livestock shelters before strong winds arrive.
Conduct early harvest for mature rice, corn, and HVCC where safe.
Prepare drainage outlets and post-event damage assessment forms with MAO and MDRRMC.

texts.bulletin: OFFICIAL PAGASA TROPICAL CYCLONE ADVISORY - City of Tuguegarao, Cagayan: TCWS Signal No. 1 is active for the province due to Maymay. Suspend field operations, secure machinery and harvested produce, avoid exposed coastal/upland areas, and coordinate with MDRRMC/MAO for pre-disaster agriculture actions.
texts.sms: PAGASA TCWS 1: Suspend farm work in City of Tuguegarao. Secure crops/equipment. Coordinate with MAO/MDRRMC.
texts.lgu:
PAGASA TCWS ADVISORY - City of Tuguegarao
Signal No. 1 is active for Cagayan.
Actions: suspend field operations, secure harvest and inputs, pre-position assessment teams, and prepare crop damage documentation.
texts.facebook:
PAGASA TCWS ALERT - City of Tuguegarao, Cagayan

Suspend farm operations and secure harvested crops, machinery, and livestock areas. Coordinate with your MAO and MDRRMC for assistance.

calendar_anchor.note: Current rice/corn stages are anchored to the municipal ACAP crop calendar.

adaptation_measures: Use mechanical dryers, covered drying floors, tarpaulins, and ventilated temporary storage.
Prioritize hauling of wet palay/corn to postharvest facilities to avoid quality losses.
Monitor grain moisture before storage and milling.

texts.bulletin: POSTHARVEST DRYING RISK - City of Tuguegarao: Drying class is high_risk. Avoid open sun-drying if rain/high humidity persists. Prioritize mechanical dryers, tarpaulins, covered temporary storage, and rapid hauling to postharvest facilities.
texts.sms: DA WARNING: Drying risk in City of Tuguegarao. Use mechanical dryer/covered storage; avoid wet grain spoilage.
texts.lgu:
POSTHARVEST ADVISORY - City of Tuguegarao
Coordinate mobile dryers, tarpaulins, and storage support for farmers harvesting rice/corn.
texts.facebook: POSTHARVEST ADVISORY - City of Tuguegarao: High drying risk. Use mechanical dryers or covered storage to protect palay/mais quality.

calendar_anchor.note: Advisory is anchored to matching current ACAP rice/corn calendar stage(s).

adaptation_measures: Coordinate field validation with MAO/AEWs before public release.
Prioritize advisories for vulnerable rainfed and smallholder production areas.
Document farm impacts for DA and PCIC support where losses are observed.

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER IRRIGATION - City of Tuguegarao: supplemental irrigation and pump operation should be deferred. Basis: recent rainfall is enough that irrigation can be paused to prevent over-saturation. ACAP calendar anchor: Aug 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Seedling; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Tasseling. Recommended action: pause irrigation to avoid over-saturation; prioritize drainage and canal checks first.
texts.sms: DA OPS: Defer irrigation in City of Tuguegarao. Recent rainfall is enough that irrigation can be paused to prevent over-saturation. Check MAO guidance.
texts.lgu:
OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER IRRIGATION - City of Tuguegarao
Operation: supplemental irrigation and pump operation
Why defer: recent rainfall is enough that irrigation can be paused to prevent over-saturation.
ACAP calendar: Aug 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Seedling; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Tasseling.
LGU/MAO action: pause irrigation to avoid over-saturation; prioritize drainage and canal checks first; inform affected barangays and reschedule support services.
texts.facebook: Operations Advisory - Defer Irrigation - City of Tuguegarao: Please defer supplemental irrigation and pump operation for now. Reason: recent rainfall is enough that irrigation can be paused to prevent over-saturation. Current crop calendar basis: Rice season 2 - Seedling; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Tasseling. Coordinate with your Municipal Agriculturist for the next safe field window.

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - City of Tuguegarao: sun-drying of palay or corn grain should be deferred. Basis: recent rain makes open-air drying unreliable. ACAP calendar anchor: Aug 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Seedling; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Tasseling. Recommended action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available.
texts.sms: DA OPS: Defer open-air grain drying in City of Tuguegarao. Recent rain makes open-air drying unreliable. Check MAO guidance.
texts.lgu:
OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - City of Tuguegarao
Operation: sun-drying of palay or corn grain
Why defer: recent rain makes open-air drying unreliable.
ACAP calendar: Aug 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Seedling; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Tasseling.
LGU/MAO action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available; inform affected barangays and reschedule support services.
texts.facebook: Operations Advisory - Defer Open-Air Grain Drying - City of Tuguegarao: Please defer sun-drying of palay or corn grain for now. Reason: recent rain makes open-air drying unreliable. calendar_anchor.note: Advisory is anchored to matching current ACAP rice/corn calendar stage(s).

adaptation_measures: Improve drainage and avoid prolonged waterlogging in low-lying fields.
Increase pest and disease scouting for fungal and bacterial disease triggers.
Use resistant varieties and integrated pest management; spray only during safe weather windows.

texts.bulletin: WET SPELL DISEASE WATCH - City of Tuguegarao: 22 consecutive wet days and high humidity may favor fungal/bacterial diseases. Increase field scouting for rice blast/sheath blight and corn fungal diseases. Spray only when rain and wind conditions are safe.
texts.sms: DA WATCH: Wet/humid days in City of Tuguegarao. Scout crops for disease; spray only in clear, low-wind weather.
texts.lgu:
DISEASE WATCH - City of Tuguegarao
Ask AEWs to intensify field scouting and report pest/disease symptoms by barangay.
texts.facebook: DISEASE WATCH - City of Tuguegarao: Wet and humid conditions. Inspect rice/corn fields and consult AEW before spraying.

texts.sms: PAGASA TCWS 1: Suspend farm work in Piat. Secure crops/equipment. Coordinate with MAO/MDRRMC.
texts.lgu:
PAGASA TCWS ADVISORY - Piat
Signal No. 1 is active for Cagayan.
Actions: suspend field operations, secure harvest and inputs, pre-position assessment teams, and prepare crop damage documentation.
texts.facebook:
PAGASA TCWS ALERT - Piat, Cagayan

Suspend farm operations and secure harvested crops, machinery, and livestock areas. Coordinate with your MAO and MDRRMC for assistance.

calendar_anchor.note: Current rice/corn stages are anchored to the municipal ACAP crop calendar.

adaptation_measures: Use mechanical dryers, covered drying floors, tarpaulins, and ventilated temporary storage.
Prioritize hauling of wet palay/corn to postharvest facilities to avoid quality losses.
Monitor grain moisture before storage and milling.

texts.bulletin: POSTHARVEST DRYING RISK - Piat: Drying class is unsuitable. Avoid open sun-drying if rain/high humidity persists. Prioritize mechanical dryers, tarpaulins, covered temporary storage, and rapid hauling to postharvest facilities.
texts.sms: DA WARNING: Drying risk in Piat. Use mechanical dryer/covered storage; avoid wet grain spoilage.
texts.lgu:
POSTHARVEST ADVISORY - Piat
Coordinate mobile dryers, tarpaulins, and storage support for farmers harvesting rice/corn.
texts.facebook: POSTHARVEST ADVISORY - Piat: High drying risk. Use mechanical dryers or covered storage to protect palay/mais quality.

calendar_anchor.note: Advisory is anchored to matching current ACAP rice/corn calendar stage(s).

adaptation_measures: Coordinate field validation with MAO/AEWs before public release.
Prioritize advisories for vulnerable rainfed and smallholder production areas.
Document farm impacts for DA and PCIC support where losses are observed.

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER IRRIGATION - Piat: supplemental irrigation and pump operation should be deferred. Basis: recent rainfall is enough that irrigation can be paused to prevent over-saturation. ACAP calendar anchor: Aug 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Seedling; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Leaf development. Recommended action: pause irrigation to avoid over-saturation; prioritize drainage and canal checks first.
texts.sms: DA OPS: Defer irrigation in Piat. Recent rainfall is enough that irrigation can be paused to prevent over-saturation. Check MAO guidance.
texts.lgu:
OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER IRRIGATION - Piat
Operation: supplemental irrigation and pump operation
Why defer: recent rainfall is enough that irrigation can be paused to prevent over-saturation.
ACAP calendar: Aug 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Seedling; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Leaf development.
LGU/MAO action: pause irrigation to avoid over-saturation; prioritize drainage and canal checks first; inform affected barangays and reschedule support services.
texts.facebook: Operations Advisory - Defer Irrigation - Piat: Please defer supplemental irrigation and pump operation for now. Reason: recent rainfall is enough that irrigation can be paused to prevent over-saturation. Current crop calendar basis: Rice season 2 - Seedling; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Leaf development. Coordinate with your Municipal Agriculturist for the next safe field window.

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - Piat: sun-drying of palay or corn grain should be deferred. Basis: high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk; recent rain makes open-air drying unreliable. ACAP calendar anchor: Aug 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Seedling; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Leaf development. Recommended action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available.

adaptation_measures: Improve drainage and avoid prolonged waterlogging in low-lying fields.
Increase pest and disease scouting for fungal and bacterial disease triggers.
Use resistant varieties and integrated pest management; spray only during safe weather windows.

texts.bulletin: WET SPELL DISEASE WATCH - Piat: 24 consecutive wet days and high humidity may favor fungal/bacterial diseases. Increase field scouting for rice blast/sheath blight and corn fungal diseases. Spray only when rain and wind conditions are safe.
texts.sms: DA WATCH: Wet/humid days in Piat. Scout crops for disease; spray only in clear, low-wind weather.
texts.lgu:
DISEASE WATCH - Piat
Ask AEWs to intensify field scouting and report pest/disease symptoms by barangay.
texts.facebook: DISEASE WATCH - Piat: Wet and humid conditions. Inspect rice/corn fields and consult AEW before spraying.

texts.bulletin: OFFICIAL PAGASA TROPICAL CYCLONE ADVISORY - Tuao, Cagayan: TCWS Signal No. 1 is active for the province due to Maymay. Suspend field operations, secure machinery and harvested produce, avoid exposed coastal/upland areas, and coordinate with MDRRMC/MAO for pre-disaster agriculture actions.

PAGASA TCWS ADVISORY - Tuao
Signal No. 1 is active for Cagayan.
Actions: suspend field operations, secure harvest and inputs, pre-position assessment teams, and prepare crop damage documentation.

PAGASA TCWS ALERT - Tuao, Cagayan

adaptation_measures: Use mechanical dryers, covered drying floors, tarpaulins, and ventilated temporary storage.

adaptation_measures: Defer fertilizer application before heavy rain to prevent nutrient loss and runoff.

texts.bulletin: FERTILIZER APPLICATION ADVISORY — Tuao: Current rainfall conditions increase risk of nutrient loss through leaching and runoff. DEFER basal and top-dress fertilizer application until 2–3 dry days are observed. Consider split-application strategy when conditions improve. For critical growth stages, consult AEW/MAO before proceeding.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Do not apply fertilizer today due to rain risk. Wait 2-3 dry days. Less waste, better yield.
texts.lgu:
AGRI-OPERATIONS ADVISORY — Tuao
Advise farmers to postpone fertilizer application. Rain will reduce fertilizer efficacy and increase runoff to waterways.
texts.facebook:
🌱 FERTILIZER REMINDER — Tuao:
Hindi magandang maglagay ng pataba ngayon dahil may ulan. Maghintay ng 2–3 araw na tuyo para mas epektibo ang pataba. #PatubaAdvice #DARFOCagayanValley

texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Do not spray pesticides when raining. Reschedule to clear morning. Saves money, protects water.

Recommended action: pause irrigation to avoid over-saturation; prioritize drainage and canal checks first.

calendar_anchor.note: Advisory is anchored to matching current ACAP rice/corn calendar stage(s).

advisories.responsible_office: PAGASA + DA RFO 02 + LGU MDRRMC + MAO
adaptation_measures: Secure harvested produce, seed stocks, fertilizer, machinery, and livestock shelters before strong winds arrive.
Conduct early harvest for mature rice, corn, and HVCC where safe.
Prepare drainage outlets and post-event damage assessment forms with MAO and MDRRMC.

texts.bulletin: OFFICIAL PAGASA TROPICAL CYCLONE ADVISORY - Diadi, Nueva Vizcaya: TCWS Signal No. 1 is active for the province due to Maymay. Suspend field operations, secure machinery and harvested produce, avoid exposed coastal/upland areas, and coordinate with MDRRMC/MAO for pre-disaster agriculture actions.
texts.sms: PAGASA TCWS 1: Suspend farm work in Diadi. Secure crops/equipment. Coordinate with MAO/MDRRMC.
texts.lgu:
PAGASA TCWS ADVISORY - Diadi
Signal No. 1 is active for Nueva Vizcaya.
Actions: suspend field operations, secure harvest and inputs, pre-position assessment teams, and prepare crop damage documentation.
texts.facebook:
PAGASA TCWS ALERT - Diadi, Nueva Vizcaya

Suspend farm operations and secure harvested crops, machinery, and livestock areas. Coordinate with your MAO and MDRRMC for assistance.

calendar_anchor.note: Current rice/corn stages are anchored to the municipal ACAP crop calendar.

adaptation_measures: Use mechanical dryers, covered drying floors, tarpaulins, and ventilated temporary storage.
Prioritize hauling of wet palay/corn to postharvest facilities to avoid quality losses.
Monitor grain moisture before storage and milling.

texts.bulletin: POSTHARVEST DRYING RISK - Diadi: Drying class is unsuitable. Avoid open sun-drying if rain/high humidity persists. Prioritize mechanical dryers, tarpaulins, covered temporary storage, and rapid hauling to postharvest facilities.
texts.sms: DA WARNING: Drying risk in Diadi. Use mechanical dryer/covered storage; avoid wet grain spoilage.
texts.lgu:
POSTHARVEST ADVISORY - Diadi
Coordinate mobile dryers, tarpaulins, and storage support for farmers harvesting rice/corn.
texts.facebook: POSTHARVEST ADVISORY - Diadi: High drying risk. Use mechanical dryers or covered storage to protect palay/mais quality.

calendar_anchor.note: Advisory is anchored to matching current ACAP rice/corn calendar stage(s).

adaptation_measures: Coordinate field validation with MAO/AEWs before public release.
Prioritize advisories for vulnerable rainfed and smallholder production areas.
Document farm impacts for DA and PCIC support where losses are observed.

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER IRRIGATION - Diadi: supplemental irrigation and pump operation should be deferred. Basis: recent rainfall is enough that irrigation can be paused to prevent over-saturation. ACAP calendar anchor: Aug 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Seedling; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Tasseling. Recommended action: pause irrigation to avoid over-saturation; prioritize drainage and canal checks first.
texts.sms: DA OPS: Defer irrigation in Diadi. Recent rainfall is enough that irrigation can be paused to prevent over-saturation. Check MAO guidance.
texts.lgu:
OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER IRRIGATION - Diadi
Operation: supplemental irrigation and pump operation
Why defer: recent rainfall is enough that irrigation can be paused to prevent over-saturation.
ACAP calendar: Aug 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Seedling; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Tasseling.

texts.facebook: Operations Advisory - Defer Irrigation - Diadi: Please defer supplemental irrigation and pump operation for now. Recommended action: defer harvest or machine entry until fields can carry workers and equipment safely.

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - Diadi: sun-drying of palay or corn grain should be deferred. Basis: rainfall increases runoff, wash-off, grain wetting, or harvest loss risk; high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk; recent rain makes open-air drying unreliable. ACAP calendar anchor: Aug 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Seedling; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Tasseling. Recommended action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available.
texts.sms: DA OPS: Defer open-air grain drying in Diadi. Rainfall increases runoff, wash-off, grain wetting, or harvest loss risk. Check MAO guidance.
texts.lgu:

Operation: sun-drying of palay or corn grain
Why defer: rainfall increases runoff, wash-off, grain wetting, or harvest loss risk; high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk; recent rain makes open-air drying unreliable.
ACAP calendar: Aug 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Seedling; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Tasseling.
LGU/MAO action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available; inform affected barangays and reschedule support services.

Coordinate with your Municipal Agriculturist for the next safe field window.

adaptation_measures: Improve drainage and avoid prolonged waterlogging in low-lying fields.
Increase pest and disease scouting for fungal and bacterial disease triggers.
Use resistant varieties and integrated pest management; spray only during safe weather windows.

texts.bulletin: WET SPELL DISEASE WATCH - Diadi: 25 consecutive wet days and high humidity may favor fungal/bacterial diseases. Increase field scouting for rice blast/sheath blight and corn fungal diseases. Spray only when rain and wind conditions are safe.
texts.sms: DA WATCH: Wet/humid days in Diadi. Scout crops for disease; spray only in clear, low-wind weather.
texts.lgu:
DISEASE WATCH - Diadi
Ask AEWs to intensify field scouting and report pest/disease symptoms by barangay.
texts.facebook: DISEASE WATCH - Diadi: Wet and humid conditions. Inspect rice/corn fields and consult AEW before spraying.

calendar_anchor.note: Advisory is anchored to matching current ACAP rice/corn calendar stage(s).

adaptation_measures: Defer fertilizer application before heavy rain to prevent nutrient loss and runoff.
Apply split fertilizer doses when field conditions improve.
Keep fertilizer stocks dry and elevated.

texts.bulletin: FERTILIZER APPLICATION ADVISORY — Diadi: Current rainfall conditions increase risk of nutrient loss through leaching and runoff. DEFER basal and top-dress fertilizer application until 2–3 dry days are observed. Consider split-application strategy when conditions improve. For critical growth stages, consult AEW/MAO before proceeding.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Do not apply fertilizer today due to rain risk. Wait 2-3 dry days. Less waste, better yield.
texts.lgu:
AGRI-OPERATIONS ADVISORY — Diadi
Advise farmers to postpone fertilizer application. Rain will reduce fertilizer efficacy and increase runoff to waterways.
texts.facebook:
🌱 FERTILIZER REMINDER — Diadi:
Hindi magandang maglagay ng pataba ngayon dahil may ulan. Maghintay ng 2–3 araw na tuyo para mas epektibo ang pataba. #PatubaAdvice #DARFOCagayanValley

texts.bulletin: Harvest disruption risk in Kayapa due to rainfall of 30.4 mm/24h. Farmers in ripening or harvesting stages should: (1) Defer combine harvester deployment to avoid bogging; (2) Protect cut stalks from further wetting; (3) Prioritize mechanical drying over sun-drying for collected grain. Postharvest drying risk is ELEVATED. Coordinate with DA mechanization service providers for mobile dryer access.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Rain risk for harvest in Kayapa. Defer harvest, use mechanical dryer if available. Call MAO for help.

HARVEST ADVISORY — Kayapa
Rainfall of 30.4 mm may disrupt ongoing harvest operations.
Recommended actions:
1. Advise farmers to assess field conditions before deploying machinery.
2. Coordinate with RCEF mechanization pool for mobile dryer deployment.
3. Issue tarpaulin assistance where needed.
4. Document areas where harvest was deferred for scheduling follow-up.

📞 Contact your Municipal Agriculturist for drying support.
